about: A small version of Python that runs on microcontrollers and other tiny devices.

prs.title: Counting an empty string matches Python when the range is backwards
prs.broken: Counting an empty string with an end before the start returned 1. Regular Python returns 0. Bytes had the same problem.
prs.changed: The shortcut for empty strings now only runs when the range is valid, so a backwards range counts nothing.
prs.matters: Code gets the same answer on a small device as it does in regular Python.
